data.purpose: One unfamiliar public recording case requested after completion of all original and three-seed tests. This is not a new training or validation set.

speech.title: A Dream Within a Dream
speech.creator: Neil Carmichael
speech.source_claim: Own work; reading of Edgar Allan Poe's 1849 poem. Reference recording may contain residual room or microphone noise; not asserted anechoic or noise-free.

noise.title: Cherry Mx reds sound for cherry gmbh wikipedia page
noise.creator: Xaqaii
noise.source_claim: Own work; Cherry MX Red keyboard sound. No claim of exhaustive listening validation.

preprocessing.channels: arithmetic mean of source channels before resampling
preprocessing.resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly full decoded recording, float64, default Kaiser(beta=5.0), constant padding; then exact half-open crop
preprocessing.noise_scaling: noise RMS equals scaled speech RMS / 10**(snr_db/20), RMS measured over whole 10 seconds including pauses
preprocessing.joint_gain: min(1, 0.95 / max(abs(reference), abs(scaled_noise), abs(reference+scaled_noise))) applied identically to all three
preprocessing.storage: 160000 float32 samples, 16000 Hz mono FLOAT WAV; no mean removal, individual output normalization, denoising of reference, or time-alignment search
preprocessing.qc_gates: finite inputs, expected source bytes/SHA1, crop in bounds, source crop RMS>1e-4, >=20% of 100ms speech frames above 10% of its peak frame RMS (energy proxy, not VAD), no input clipping after joint gain, achieved SNR within 1e-5 dB
preprocessing.qc_failure_policy: stop and report the technical failure before any model inference; never replace source or crop based on model scores

models.policy: Use frozen accepted seed17 E4 and matched E3c, no new model selection, checkpoint selection, retraining, tuning, alternate seeds, or expanded SNR sweep. Report all outcomes including negative ones.

inference.primary_comparison: E4 minus E3c, both existing TorchFrameProcessor + StreamingDSP, independent reset state and explicit EOF flush
inference.deployment_check: accepted E4 ONNX through identical StreamingDSP; maxabs versus E4 PyTorch incremental must be <=1e-4, report all output lengths and errors
inference.offline_check: E4 and E3c incremental versus existing Enhancer.tensor offline, each maxabs<=1e-4
inference.listening: E4 ONNX output, E3c PyTorch incremental, noisy mixture, reference, and scaled keyboard noise; PCM16 copies use exactly the same fixed gain, no per-file loudness adjustment
inference.timing: Record one-run wall time only as provenance, not a new latency benchmark or device deployment claim

metrics.optional_metrics: PESQ and DNSMOS not added for this bounded case
metrics.unit_of_evidence: One 10-second synthetic mixture from one external keyboard recording and one public speech recording; no confidence interval, significance, or population generalization claim

source_exclusion_limits: Audit excludes all 14 registered additional noise recording IDs and 12 creator accounts, original official demo, and all registered VoiceBank source-file hashes.

VoiceBank source metadata uses anonymous speaker IDs and lacks original noise recording IDs. Different platforms/accounts and file hashes do not prove different natural persons or rule out transformed reposts.

Both new source pages describe own work. Neither source is included in this project's recorded training/validation/test manifests; unknown physical identity or undocumented upstream overlap cannot be categorically excluded.
No E2 official pretrained model is run; its full training sources are unknown.
